title: Interior $W^{2,p}$ regularity for the sigma-$2$ equation
summary: We prove that continuous $2$-convex solutions of the $σ_{2}$ equation with a density bounded above and below by positive constants belong to $W^{2,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ in every dimension. If, in addition, the density is continuous, the solutions belong to $W^{2,p}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ for every $1<p<\infty$.
